title: Eli Lilly plans to use its $7.3B cash reserve to fund an "App Store" for biotech scientists after launching a data center with 1,016 Blackwell chips in 2025 (Patrick Temple-West/Financial Times)
summary: Patrick Temple-West / Financial Times: Eli Lilly plans to use its $7.3B cash reserve to fund an “App Store” for biotech scientists after launching a data center with 1,016 Blackwell chips in 2025 — Mounjaro maker is collaborating with small biotechs on AI as a tool for drug discovery
